wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season | year = 2021–22 | team = Oakland Golden Grizzlies | sport = Basketball | image = Oakland Golden Grizzlies wordmark Oakland.svg | image_size = | conference = Horizon League | short_conf = Horizon | CoachRank = | APRank = | record = 20–12 | conf_record = 12–7 | head_coach = [[Greg Kampe]] | hc_year = 38th | assoc_coach = Jeff Smith | asst_coach2 = [[Tony Jones (basketball)|Tony Jones]] | asst_coach3 = Mychal Covington | stadium = [[Athletics Center O'rena]] | champion = [[Gulf Coast Showcase]] champions }} {{2021–22 Horizon League men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball team''' represented [[Oakland University]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Golden Grizzlies, led by 38th-year head coach [[Greg Kampe]], played their home games at the [[Athletics Center O'rena]] in [[Auburn Hills, Michigan]] as members of the [[Horizon League]]. They finished the season 20–12, 12–7 in Horizon League play to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2021–22 IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball team|IUPUI]] in the first round of the [[2022 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 Wright State Raiders men's basketball team|Wright State]] in the quarterfinals. They declined an invitation to [[2022 The Basketball Classic|The Basketball Classic]] postseason tournament due to injuries to several players.{{Cite web |last=Paul |first=Tony |title=Detroit Mercy men's basketball plays on in 2022, will meet FGCU in secondary tournament |url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/2022/03/14/detroit-mercy-mens-hoops-play-basketball-classic/7036628001/ |access-date=2022-03-16 |website=The Detroit News |language=en-US}} == Previous season == In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball team|Golden Grizzlies]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 12–18, 10–10 in Horizon League play to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Youngstown State Penguins men's basketball team|Youngstown State]] and [[2020–21 Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball team|Northern Kentucky]] in the [[2021 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team|Cleveland State]] in the championship game. == Roster == {{CBB
